# [Whoop 5.0 Battery only lasting 7 days](/t/whoop-5-0-battery-only-lasting-7-days/2137)

What battery life are folks seeing out of their 5.0?

I’m far from the claimed 14 days and managed to only get 7 days from 100% to 10%. A couple of bike rides, relaxation breathing and 2 meditations…

Latest whoop firmware paired with Android Pixel 9.

I’m at 50% after 7 days so on track so far with the 14 day expectation

I charged after 7 days at like 23%, so I’m guessing I could maybe get 10 days out of it but from what I’m gathering with other people’s experience, the battery life is wildly inconsistent

Hey gang, thanks for the notes. One of the biggest things that can drain battery life is the HR Broadcast feature when it’s turned on. If you go to “More” → “Device Settings” → Then look at the bottom and you’ll see the Broadcast Heart Rate toggle. When that’s toggled on, it can drain the battery faster. Is yours on or off [@hauskatze](/u/hauskatze) [@Fotocraphy](/u/fotocraphy)? You’ll see mine is toggled off. My battery is lasting 14 days similar to [@redjack63](/u/redjack63).

I’m having the same issue. Down from 100% to 10% in 4 days. No broadcast enabled. I’ll contact support.

My WHOOP 5.0 battery life has been pretty terrible so far. I wanted to verify it instead of guessing, so I tracked it:

100% / off charger: 2:30 PM on 5/11  
Last sync / apparent battery depletion: 2:24 AM on 5/15

That comes out to 83 hours 54 minutes, or about 3.5 days.

Additional details:  
Firmware: 50.38.1.0  
Broadcast Heart Rate: off  
Device: WHOOP 5.0

So I’m nowhere near the claimed 14 days, and I’m even below the 7 days some people are reporting.

Hey there! Please reach out to our support team directly at [support@whoop.com](mailto:support@whoop.com) so they can further assist with this!
